changelog.summary: PSY1 module (US-101): 13 families (`p1_*`), `psy1_full`/`psy1_short` blueprints, contract additions (13 new EngineType/GeneratorId + typed params) transcribed from docs/content/psy1-spec.md §4. No engine is registered for any PSY1 family yet; every family/section shows "Bientôt" until its own story (US-102..116) lands.

Calibration seed banks for dominos/cube-net/viewpoint (US-084): 40+20+20 generated-recipe items picked by tool/calibration/pick_seeds.dart, covering the 1-5 difficulty distribution. Not sampled by the launcher yet (generated families ignore bank items); a corpus for US-086 calibration and a future curated-series mode.

US-087 content review & QA pass: French typography fixes (NBSP, guillemets) across culture_aero, english and decks; culture.instruments tags merged into culture.flight_mechanics (14 documented topics); fact-checked perishable culture_aero figures.
French lexical-field bank for Boîte à mots (US-085): 45 fields, ~20 words each, with traps and incompatibleWith.
Flashcard decks (US-042): culture_aero, arithmetic_grid, english, logic_dominos, memory_nback, attention_rules.
Initial PSY0 bundle: 16 families, psy0_full / psy0_short blueprints, English bank, lessons.
